theorem_title: The suffix query host computes the exact Möbius value
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingSuffixQueryHost.program_meets
    {μ : ℕ → ℤ} {W V offset cut stage t baseL baseR boxCut boxBase maskBase work B D d : ℕ}
    (hfit : offset+V ≤ W) (Q : Finset (Fin V)) (preL preR : Finset (Fin W))
    (f g : Finset (Fin W) → ℤ)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hcut : cut ≤ W) (hstage : stage ≤ W)
    (hdataL : baseL+(W+1)*_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap W cut ≤ maskBase)
    (hdataR : baseR+(W+1)*_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap W cut ≤ maskBase)
    (hdataBox : boxBase+(V+1)*_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap V boxCut ≤ maskBase)
    (hmasks : maskBase+_root_.ThreeSum.LightSparseQuery.queryItems Q.card t ≤ work)
    (hspace : work+1+_root_.ThreeSum.LightPascal.tableSize W+(W+1) ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (((W+1)*2^(W+1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hvalueWord : (_root_.ThreeSum.LightSparseQuery.magnitudeBound V stage Q.card t B D : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (ht : t ≤ Q.card+1) (hboxCut : boxCut ≤ Q.card) (hflags : Q.card-t ≤ boxCut)
    (hdisjL : Disjoint preL (_root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSuffix.liftSet hfit Q)) (hdisjR : Disjoint preR (_root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSuffix.liftSet hfit Q))
    (hcardL : (preL ∪ _root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSuffix.liftSet hfit Q).card ≤ cut)
    (hcardR : (preR ∪ _root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSuffix.liftSet hfit Q).card ≤ cut)
    (hf : ∀ T, T.card ≤ cut → |f T| ≤ B)
    (hg : ∀ T, T.card ≤ cut → |g T| ≤ D)
    (hstoredL : _root_.ThreeSum.LightZetaStages.StoredThrough μ baseL cut f W)
    (hstoredR : _root_.ThreeSum.LightZetaStages.StoredThrough μ baseR cut g W)
    (hstoredBox : _root_.ThreeSum.LightBoxStages.StoredThrough μ boxBase boxCut (_root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSuffix.leafWeight hfit f g stage preL preR) V)
    (hd : d+W+10 ≤ lim.depth) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingSuffixQueryHost.program 30 d
      [W,cut,stage,preL.card,_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.subsetMask preL,preR.card,_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.subsetMask preR,V,offset,
        Q.card,_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.subsetMask (_root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSuffix.liftSet hfit Q),t,baseL,baseR,boxCut,boxBase,maskBase,work]
      μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightReportingSuffixQueryHost.time W V Q.card t)
      (fun r μ' =>
        r = _root_.ThreeSum.Subset.mobius (fun S => _root_.ThreeSum.SubsetStages.stageValue f stage (preL ∪ S)*
          _root_.ThreeSum.SubsetStages.stageValue g stage (preR ∪ S)) (_root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSuffix.liftSet hfit Q) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.KeptBut μ μ' work maskBase (_root_.ThreeSum.LightSparseQuery.queryItems Q.card t)) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Embed a suffix query set $Q$ of width $V$ at offset $o$ in total width $W$. Let two fixed prefixes be disjoint from the lifted query, with their unions inside the source cutoff. Suppose bounded source functions $f,g$, their retained zeta stages, and the suffix box stages are stored. Under the stated cutoffs, stage bound, sparse threshold, array/scratch layout, word and accumulator bounds, and call depth, procedure 30 returns the Möbius sum of the product of the two prefix-shifted stage values over the lifted query, preserving all but allowed query workspace and scratch.

This semantic query contract justifies reading the machine result as the exact original prefix count after the transform bridge.
